description: This file defines the Banner controller class for the admin side of an OpenCart project, handling tasks related to banners such as generating lists, retrieving banner info, creating files, and cleaning up generated content.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing banner-related tasks such as listing, generating banner data files, and cleanup within the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes and generates banner tasks for each store and language combination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates JSON files containing banners for a specific store and language.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Creates detailed banner information JSON file for a specific banner, store, and language.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all generated banner JSON files from the filesystem for all stores and languages.
